event.label: reported
event.text: The Cockroach Janta Party called a protest at Rajendra Maidan in Kochi on Saturday demanding withdrawal of the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls, its first major protest since the arrests of its co-convenors at Delhi's Jantar Mantar last month, The Week reports. Founder Abhijeet Dipke posted ahead of it: "It's not over until we say it's over." Union Minister Jitendra Singh has said there is "sufficient evidence" of unauthorised funding of the party, which its co-convenors call baseless; how the Kochi protest went had not been reported yet.

event.label: confirmed
event.text: The Cockroach Janta Party announced its support for the opposition INDIA bloc's scheduled November 1 rally, demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged voter deletions during the Special Intensive Revision exercise, Deccan Chronicle and Outlook report.
